source: 人教版2019选择性必修二 Unit 5 同主题完形(我学会急救/给烫伤降温/一通救命电话/化学烧伤处理/扭伤脚踝/海姆立克法步骤)。用词限 U5/初中/常见词,答案唯一,与阅读关不撞文章。答案位稍后打散。

passages.title: Why I Took a First-Aid Course
passages.text: Last summer I joined a first-aid (1)____ at the Red Cross. At first I thought it would be (2)____, but the lessons turned out to be very useful. We learned how to stay (3)____ instead of panicking when someone is hurt. Our teacher said that the most important thing is to act fast but never (4)____. We practised cleaning a (5)____ and covering it with a clean cloth. We also learned what to do when a person is (6)____ on food and cannot breathe. By the end of the course, I felt (7)____ that I could help in a real emergency. A few weeks later, my little brother (8)____ his ankle while playing, and I knew exactly what to do. I helped him sit down and then called my mum for (9)____. That day I understood why everyone should learn these simple (10)____.

but 表转折,与 useful 相对,前面以为'无聊'→ boring。

never panic 永远别惊慌。
cleaning a wound 清洗伤口。
choking on food 被食物噎住。
felt confident 感到自信。
sprained his ankle 扭伤脚踝。
call for help 求助。
simple skills 简单技能。

passages.title: Cooling a Small Burn
passages.text: One evening, my sister touched a hot pan and burnt her (1)____. She screamed in pain, but I remembered the right (2)____ to take. First, I led her to the sink and put the burn under cool running (3)____. I kept it there for about ten (4)____, which stopped the heat and (5)____ the pain. Then I gently (6)____ the area with a clean cloth. I did not put any oil on it, because oil keeps the heat (7)____ and can cause infection. After that, I covered the burn (8)____ with a clean cloth so that it stayed safe. My sister soon felt much (9)____. The burn was only a small one, so we did not need to go to (10)____, but I was glad I knew what to do.

cool running water 凉的流动水。

passages.title: The Call That Saved Grandpa
passages.text: One night, a boy was at home with his (1)____ when the old man suddenly fell to the floor and stopped moving. The boy did not (2)____. He quickly picked up the phone and called the emergency (3)____. A calm operator answered and asked him to (4)____ a few simple questions. The operator kept talking to him so that he would not feel (8)____. A few minutes later, an (9)____ arrived, and the paramedics took over. passages.title: First Aid for a Chemical Burn
passages.text: A chemical burn happens when your skin or eyes come into contact with an (1)____ or other dangerous chemicals. Such burns can be very (2)____ and need urgent attention. If the chemical is (3)____, it can even harm your internal (4)____. So first aid must be given (5)____. Begin by washing the burnt area with plenty of cool (6)____ to remove the chemical. Be careful not to let it (7)____ to other parts of the skin. After washing, (8)____ the area loosely with a clean cloth. Do not rub the skin, as this may make the (9)____ worse. Most importantly, send the person to (10)____ right away if he or she is badly burnt, because only a doctor can treat a serious chemical burn safely.

very dangerous 非常危险。
if the chemical is swallowed 如果被吞下。
internal organs 内脏器官。
given immediately 立即进行。
cool water 凉水。
let it spread 让它扩散。
wrap the area 包住该处。
make the burn worse 使烧伤更糟。
send… to hospital 送往医院。

passages.title: When Nancy Hurt Her Ankle

passages.title: How the Heimlich Manoeuvre Works
passages.text: When a person is (1)____ on food and cannot speak, every second matters. One quick and (2)____ way to help is the Heimlich manoeuvre. If this does not work, stand (6)____ the victim and wrap your arms around the waist. Make a (7)____ with one hand and place it on the upper part of the stomach. (8)____ your fist tightly with your other hand, then push up and into the stomach in one (9)____. Keep doing this until the food is forced (10)____. With a small child, however, you should not do this, as you may hurt the child; instead, lay the child face down and give firm slaps to the upper back.
